name: status-monitor
description: Runs a shell command and reflects output as a colored status bar icon

statusMonitor.envVariable.description: Environment variable name to read (passed to the command as env)

statusMonitor.intervalSeconds.description: How often to re-run the command (seconds)

statusMonitor.successPattern.description: Regex pattern in output that means SUCCESS (green)

statusMonitor.warningPattern.description: Regex pattern in output that means WARNING (yellow)

statusMonitor.label.description: Default text label shown in the status bar next to the icon (used when a status-specific label is not set)

statusMonitor.labelSuccess.description: Label shown when status is success (falls back to statusMonitor.label)

statusMonitor.labelWarning.description: Label shown when status is warning (falls back to statusMonitor.label)

statusMonitor.labelFailure.description: Label shown when status is error (falls back to statusMonitor.label)
